item.title: KAIST Humanoid Robot Runs, Jumps, and Moonwalks in New Footage Shared on X
item.summary: KAIST's 75 kg humanoid robot demonstrates running, jumping, moonwalking, and soccer in demonstration footage shared on X by AI influencer Ronald van Loon on August 7, 2026, with secondary coverage identifying the platform as Humanoid v0.7 controlled via deep reinforcement learning.
